descriptionChirho: To physically cut, carve, or inscribe marks into a surface such as stone or metal (Qal active).
To be carved or inscribed upon a surface, the passive result of engraving (Qal passive participle and Hofal).
To issue decrees or enact statutes with binding authority, the legislative act of establishing ordinances (Piel/Pual verbal action).
One who enacts laws or exercises governing authority, used substantively of a person in a position of legislative or ruling power (Piel participle as substantive).
The staff or scepter symbolizing ruling authority, a metonymic extension from the lawgiver to the instrument of his office (Piel participle used metonymically).
